# Help menu

The Help menu has the manuals and documentation of all three ECU's, whatever file is open.

## Help → T5, T7 and T8

Each has a submenu with the User manual, this book for that ECU, and the Trionic N documentation, Dilemma's book about that ECU.

## Help → Release notes

Opens the releases page with what changed in each version.

## Help → Check for updates

Looks for a newer TxSuite and shows the result in the status bar.
When there is one it asks, OK downloads the setup on Windows and opens the release page elsewhere.
TxSuite also checks when it starts.

## Help → About TxSuite

The version, and the people who made the suites possible.
TxSuite was created with the help of lots of people on ecuproject.com and trionictuning.com.
